settings.heading: Why they don't slide down
settings.text: Most strap knee pads stay up one way: a tight band across the back of the knee. Holdfast uses two straps, one above the knee and one below, lined with silicone that grips your pants.

settings.title: Hard shell cap
settings.text: Stands up to concrete, gravel and loose screws, so the cushion underneath lasts longer.

settings.title: Gel cushion over foam
settings.text: Gel spreads your weight across the pad instead of the point of your kneecap. High-density foam underneath keeps it supported through a full day.

settings.title: Two adjustable straps
settings.text: One strap sits above the knee and one below, so neither has to be cranked tight and nothing presses into the back of your knee.

settings.title: Silicone grip lining
settings.text: A silicone strip inside each strap holds onto your pant leg, so the pad stays over your knee when you stand, walk or climb a ladder.

30-day returns
settings.text: Wear them on the job for a full week. If they slide down, pinch, or just aren't right for you, contact us within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

settings.question: Will they stay up when I stand?
settings.answer: That's what they're designed to do. The silicone lining inside each strap grips your pants, and the two straps hold the pad over your kneecap instead of relying on one tight band. If they still slide, send them back within 30 days.

settings.question: Do the straps cut off circulation?
settings.answer: They shouldn't. One strap sits above the knee and one below, so nothing presses into the back of the joint. Tighten them until the pad doesn't shift, then stop.

settings.question: What size do I need?
settings.answer: One size fits most adults. Both straps adjust, and the pads fit over jeans, work pants and bib overalls.

settings.question: Will the cap scratch finished floors?
settings.answer: It can. The hard cap is made for subfloor, concrete and tile. On finished hardwood or vinyl, put down a drop cloth like you would with any hard-cap pad.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is free to anywhere in the US. You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return them for a full refund, even if you've worn them on the job. Send us a message with your order number to start a return.
